features: Homepage SIGNAL MATRIX: previous-day HA semantic dot to the LEFT of existing yellow/purple average-K text. Dot color = previous day; height = raw HA close comparison. Same six-case and anomaly protection as MultiAssetLiquidityRadar v2.0.7; snapshot-only, no indicator/API/Worker changes.

Real-time Monitor and Liquidity Radar use the existing shared SState OTHER-UP/OTHER-DN classification, showing OT-UP/OT-DN in compact S-state columns with matching colors, tooltips and sorting; Champion training, R2 stored formal states and probability models remain unchanged.

Homepage ONLY: classify formal OTHER as OTHER-UP when last-day yellow HA is at BB position >=0.85, at least 2 of last 3 days stay >=0.85 and HA advances; mirrored OTHER-DN uses purple HA, <=0.15 and falling HA. Non-qualifying OTHER remains OTHER.
Keep formal market_state_id, Champion 72H probabilities, stored snapshot, Cloudflare Worker and Telegram unchanged; homepage and SIGNAL MATRIX filters/badges use presentation-only extension.
Main site version chip now reads root VERSION.json (cache-busted), with config.js as a fallback; script cache keys updated to v0.3.20.
Liquidity radar v1.1.6 changes CoinGlass max-pain lookup from 24h to 7d while leaving the BTC short-horizon probability model and all other SState features unchanged.
Radar price alert explicitly selects ABOVE or BELOW and Cloudflare Worker triggers only on an actual post-save crossing, not when price merely satisfies >= or <=
R2 stores last observed price and armed state, with server-side baseline from TradingView Scanner; browser closure still supported
Adds a bell beside every live price for creating a one-shot Telegram price alert.
Automatically decides ABOVE/BELOW direction from the current price and the target price.
Stores active alerts in R2 so the bell state is shared across devices.
While monitor.html is open, the Worker checks active alerts every 10 seconds; an optional Cloudflare every-minute cron keeps alerts working when the page is closed.
On a successful Telegram send, the triggered alert is automatically deleted.
Telegram message format is: SYMBOL   觸發TARGET followed by Taiwan time.
Integrate MultiAssetLiquidityRadar v1.1.3 as an independent GitHub Pages subfolder using the parent SState monitor-engine.js.
Main navigation: replace quick 即時監控 with 清算監控 (new tab); move original 即時監控 link into 更多.
Watch MultiAssetLiquidityRadar/** in GitHub Pages deployment workflow so subsequent radar-only pushes redeploy.

WTI_USDT_PERP alert TradingView ticker aliases to PIONEX:CLUSDT.P in the Cloudflare Worker (requires Worker redeployment for WTI alerts).
